content:
Tyler Benson: hey #help — looking for quick Data/RevOps guidance on measuring *influence* for the new customer reference program.

We need a consistent way in HubSpot to tag deals where:
1) a reference call happened, and/or
2) a case study / 1-pager was used in late stage

Goal is to report “% of late-stage opps that used a reference” + directional win-rate lift (not claiming sourced). What’s the cleanest approach? @Isabelle Laurent can you pull in RevOps? :pray:

Isabelle Laurent: yep, looping in @Nina Patel (RevOps) and @Jordan Blake (RevOps/Systems). we’ve been talking about this for other enablement assets too.

Camila Reyes: +1. We don’t need perfection, but we do need something reps will actually do + that we can audit later. Also needs to differentiate “sent asset” vs “customer took reference call”.

Nina Patel: jumping in. couple options in HubSpot, depends on how much friction you can tolerate.

Recommended (low lift, decent fidelity):
- Create 2 deal properties (both reportable):
  1) `Reference program used` (checkbox)
  2) `Reference touchpoints` (multi-select: “Reference call completed”, “Reference call requested (not completed)”, “Case study link sent”, “Case study PDF sent”, “Customer quote shared”, “Webinar/event mention”)
- Add 1 date property:
  3) `Reference call completed date`
- Require reps/CSMs to log one note or call activity with a prefix in the subject, e.g. `REFCALL - Northwind - Prospect: <company>`. Not perfect but helps spot-check.

If you want higher fidelity (more work): use a custom object “Reference Engagement” associated to Deal + Company, but that’s a bigger build.

Jordan Blake: +1 to Nina’s reco. Also, for “case study used”, we can get *some* tracking if you send as HubSpot “Documents” (tracked link) vs random PDFs. If Marketing hosts on docs site, add UTM + tracked short link for sales enablement so we can attribute at least “clicked”.

Avery Johnson: honest take: reps will not remember to update 3 fields unless it’s in the deal stage checklist. Can we make it part of the stage change to “Security Review / Legal” or “Procurement”?

Nina Patel: yes. We can add a lightweight workflow:
- When deal moves into (Proposal/Security/Procurement) → prompt task: “Did you use a reference call or customer story?” with link to update the properties.
- Optional: make `Reference program used` required on stage transition for Enterprise pipeline only. (We can scope by pipeline.)

Isabelle Laurent: for reporting, we can then slice:
- count of closed-won where `Reference program used = true`
- win rate for deals with that flag vs without
- time-in-stage deltas (late stage only) if we want a narrative

Camila Reyes: this sounds right. one nuance: we should avoid counting “requested but never happened” as real influence. can we separate?

Jordan Blake: yep. That’s why multi-select is good. In reporting, we filter on `Reference touchpoints contains “Reference call completed”` for the stronger claim. “Case study link sent/PDF sent” can be a softer metric.

Tyler Benson: makes sense. how do we keep data clean? I’m worried we’ll end up with touchpoints marked but no record.

Nina Patel: guardrails:
- define in the playbook: “Only mark ‘Reference call completed’ after the call happens and is logged.”
- we can add a validation rule via required `Reference call completed date` when touchpoint contains “Reference call completed” (HubSpot can’t do perfect conditional required everywhere, but we can approximate with a workflow + reminder task)
- spot audit: weekly list of deals flagged + no call activity with `REFCALL` keyword

Isabelle Laurent: I can own the audit report + share in #marketing / #sales once a week during the 8–10 week push.

Avery Johnson: +1. also pls make the fields dead simple in the UI. I’ll get pushback otherwise :sweat_smile:

Camila Reyes: action items?

Nina Patel: proposing:
1) RevOps creates the 3 deal properties (today/tomorrow)
2) Isabelle updates the reference request playbook with exact definitions + the `REFCALL` logging convention
3) Tyler updates the intake form / brief template to include “Deal ID / HubSpot link” and “Mark touchpoint after call” reminder

Jordan Blake: and I’ll add a saved view + basic dashboard tiles:
- “Opps with reference call completed (last 30d)”
- “Closed-won influenced by reference (quarter)”

Tyler Benson: perfect. thanks all. tagging this for follow-up once the properties exist so we can align naming with the Confluence workflow. :thumbsup:

(Reaction: Camila Reyes added :thumbsup:)
(Reaction: Avery Johnson added :white_check_mark:)
